text:
The ICD v1 layout makes Folding leg the base and ties every interface (table top and all four brackets) to Folding leg #1, so legs #2, #3 and #4 have no interface placing them and float. The approved part models are not at fault, and no single interface number can fix this. The table top envelope (100 × 70 × 16 mm, the same as a hinge bracket) is also implausibly small for a table with 568 mm legs, so it should be re-sized in the same revision.

The legs float because the layout hangs everything off one leg. I propose revising to ICD v2: Table top as the base, one hinge bracket per corner mounted on the top, and each folding leg mounted on its own bracket, standing upright at 90 × 20 × 568 mm. I also suggest re-sizing the table top to 800 × 600 × 20 mm, since 100 × 70 mm is a bracket-sized top. Please adjust that size if the brief has a different one. The fasteners and the kept parts carry over.

This needs your decision first: Revise the program to ICD v2 (Table top is the base; Leg hinge bracket mounts on Table top; Folding leg mounts on Leg hinge bracket; 3 more changes): 4 kept, 0 re-placed, 3 redesigned; 3 assemblies run again; about 78 tokens and 7.6 min (it reopens parts already worked on).
